name.en: Standing Wrist Radial and Ulnar Deviation

purpose.zh: 活动手腕，练习左右偏的控制
purpose.en: Mobilize the wrist and control its side-to-side movement.

text.zh: 掌心朝下，手腕向拇指侧再向小指侧摆
text.en: Palm down, move your wrist toward the thumb side, then the little-finger side

text.zh: 肘弯曲固定，前臂不转动
text.en: Keep your elbow bent and still and your forearm from rotating.
Move slowly and gently without forcing it.

cautions.zh: 出现疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If you feel pain, reduce the range, and stop if it continues.
